title: The sharp Laptev-Safronov threshold and a Lorentz-stable tube obstruction
exact_target: Determine sharp complex Schrödinger eigenvalue bounds, a trace-class endpoint, semiclassical resolvent growth, and pseudomodes for discontinuous potentials.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 20002499 (AIM-PHYSICS-0007). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
American Institute of Mathematics, Mathematical aspects of physics with non-self-adjoint operators; workshop 8–12 June 2015, Problems 7.1–10.1.
